revisions.text: You lost Ivy, directionless, but I see beyond what your heart wants. I see what you need. Summon me.
You are lost, Ivy, directionless, but I see beyond what your heart wants. I see what you need. Summon me.
You're lost Ivy.  Directionless.  But I see beyond what your heart wants… I see what you need.  Summon The Archmother so that she may provide it.
